name: The Deserters
summary: Captain Garran Vimes says deserters have settled into a tower that Theramore had abandoned. The tower stands at Lost Point, which lies southeast of the inn. A man called Jacken leads the deserters, and Vimes wants information about Reethe from him.

sections.title: A Tower Taken
sections.body: Vimes admits that holding on in the marsh has been a struggle, though the resolve of Vimes's people has kept several defensive watchtowers standing. Scouting reports say deserters have moved into an abandoned one at Lost Point, which lies southeast of the inn. A man named Jacken leads them. Vimes asks you to see what information Jacken will give up about Reethe, and warns that Jacken may not part with it easily.

faq.q: Who sends you to deal with the deserters?
faq.answer: Captain Garran Vimes, whose scouting reports say deserters have settled into one of the towers Theramore abandoned.
At Lost Point, which lies southeast of the inn, in an abandoned tower in Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.q: Who leads the deserters at Lost Point?
faq.answer: A man called Jacken, or Balos Jacken, leads them. Vimes warns that Jacken may not give up information easily.

faq.q: What does Captain Vimes want from Balos Jacken?
faq.answer: Information about Reethe, from Jacken and the deserters.
